scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run gen && npm -w apps/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run gen && npm -w apps/web run dev
scripts.build: npm run gen && npm -w packages/shared run build && npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run gen && npm -w packages/shared run typecheck && npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run gen && npm -w packages/shared run lint && npm -w apps/api run lint && npm -w apps/web run lint
scripts.test: npm run gen && npm -w apps/api run test && npm -w apps/web run test
